titulo: One topic, many audiences: promoavatar and promoavatar3
hero_alt: A grid of twelve vertical screens, each with a different audience, over an editing desk.
lead: The same topic doesn't persuade a young person and a retiree in the same way. promoavatar writes one script for each of 12 audiences; promoavatar3 writes three for the same audience: reach, authority, and promotional. In both, the bot writes and stops. You approve before spending avatar and render.
objetivo: plan 3 videos for the same audience (reach, authority, promotional) with the two gates and the contract title of each avatar.

aprende.t: The 12 audiences and the trigger for each
The two gates: before the avatar and before the render
Why the video title is a contract

secoes.sub: Four phases and two gates. The pipeline stops on its own at the gates and only moves on when you release it.

nos.detalhe: The agent saves one script per audience and sends each one in the chat with the exact title of the video. This is the first gate: you review it, and only then give /aprovar. Swapping the cover at this point is free.

Who generates the avatar video. The default is you, in the HeyGen studio. There are routes where the bot generates it (script in the studio, credits, API), but only one per flow: two would generate the same video twice.
It looks in the studio for the video with the exact title and downloads it. One character off and nothing is found. Second gate: you check the downloaded avatars before spending the render queue.
Builds the 9:16 reel and delivers it to that audience's channel. Delivery is the last step of the pipeline: the canal field of each audience in flow.json says where it goes.

secoes.legenda: Approving first is worth more than retrying later: avatar and render cost money and can't be undone. The first gate protects the avatar spend; the second protects the render spend.

secoes.titulo: Three videos for the same audience (promoavatar3)
secoes.sub: Publish in this order: reach → authority → promotional.

texto: Goal: stop the scroll and get shared.
CTA: comment or share. Never commercial.
Goal: teach something concrete and get saved.
CTA: save, follow, or try it.
Goal: connect the pain to the solution.
everyday person, young people, professionals, women, entrepreneurs, technicians, 40+, 60+, educators, creators, career restart, and family. Each audience has its own trigger and its own channel.

exemplo.texto: Your experience is worth more when AI multiplies it.

secoes.sub: Bot commands (inemaccbot). For your channel, what matters is the pattern: filter, see the plan, approve.

blocos.conteudo:
# see the plan without spending anything (does not queue)
/promoavatar3 <assunto> | alvos=jovens-alc,jovens-aut,jovens-pro | sombra

# run for just one audience, across all three types
/promoavatar3 <assunto> | alvos=jovens-alc,jovens-aut,jovens-pro

# after reviewing the texts
/aprovar C#7

promoavatar:   A<N>-<publico>-v1        ex.: A8-mulheres-v1
promoavatar3:  C<N>-<publico>-<tipo>-v1 ex.: C7-jovens-pro-v1

Download matches by exact equality. Short suffixes (alc, aut, pro):
a long title was already truncated in the studio and broke the match.

# Same subject, same audience: <audience>

Subject: 
Audience trigger: 

| Type | Length | Goal | CTA | Title in the studio |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| reach | 25–40 s | get shared | comment or share | |

Result (comments in 7 days): alc __ · aut __ · pro __

abas.html:
• promoavatar: one video per audience, 12 audiences. Reference A#N.
  • promoavatar3: three videos per audience (alc, aut, pro), 36 possible targets. Reference C#N. The usual approach is to filter with | alvos=.
  • They are separate systems: changing one doesn't affect the other.

| prompt=viral: reach above all. No brand, no course, and no inema.club in the script; the CTA is always about engagement, with free length from 15 to 45 s. The final clip becomes just the brand, so it doesn't compete with the request to comment.

secoes.sub: The avatars are in the studio. The download looks for each one by its exact title.

msg.inicio: 5 avatars ready in the studio. Click "Baixar e montar".
msg.rodando: Looking up each video by its exact title, downloading it, and assembling the reel.
msg.parou: Interrupted. Whatever was downloading goes back to the queue on the next round.
msg.retoma: Resumed: whatever already became a reel is not redone.
msg.fim: All reels delivered to the audience's channel.
msg.fimfalha: One video was not found: in the studio it was saved as "C7-40mais-alcance-v1". A title outside the contract never matches.

secoes.legenda: Illustrative simulation in the browser. The failure is on purpose: a title typed from memory, with the long suffix.

exercicios.titulo: Challenge · 3 videos for the same audience
exercicios.texto: Write meus-3-videos.md for an audience in your niche, publish in the order reach → authority → promotional, and note the comments on each one.
exercicios.pronto: all three went out with titles that follow the contract pattern, and you know which of the three brought the most comments.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: At what point is changing a reel's cover image free?
opcoes: At the text-phase gate, before any avatar or render.
After the reel has been assembled.
perguntas.explica: At the text gate, no avatar, image, or render has been generated yet. After that, changing it means redoing the reel.

perguntas.p: What is the CTA of a reach video?
opcoes: Subscribe to the channel and the course.
perguntas.explica: Reach is meant to stop the scroll and get shared. The invitation to the website belongs in the promotional video.

perguntas.p: The video was saved in the studio as "C7-jovens-promocional-v1". What happens at download?
opcoes: It's not found: the title has to be exactly C7-jovens-pro-v1.
The bot fixes the name by itself.
It downloads the version without captions.
perguntas.explica: The download matches by exact text equality. That's why the chat sends the finished title, so it isn't typed from memory.

opcoes: To see the plan (phase × target × queue) without queuing anything or spending anything.
perguntas.explica: With "| sombra" the bot only prints the plan. That's how you check a new topic before spending GPU.
